recipes.title: Install approved Ubuntu/Debian security updates
recipes.expected_change: Install updates from the endpoint's approved security repositories.
recipes.restart_requirement: A restart may be required when /var/run/reboot-required exists; SecureScope must leave the execution in Pending restart.
recipes.rollback_action: Use the approved package rollback or recovery procedure for the affected package; rollback is never automatic.
recipes.required_privilege: root through the Wazuh agent service
recipes.expected_duration: 5 to 45 minutes depending on repository and package state
recipes.validation_method: Run package post-checks and a targeted Nuclei or OpenVAS verification scan.

recipes.title: Install approved Windows security and critical updates
recipes.expected_change: Install applicable Windows updates categorized as Security Updates or Critical Updates.
recipes.restart_requirement: The Windows Update result may require a reboot; SecureScope must leave the execution in Pending restart.
recipes.rollback_action: Use the organization's approved Windows update uninstall or recovery procedure; rollback is never automatic.
recipes.required_privilege: LocalSystem or administrator through the Wazuh agent service
recipes.expected_duration: 10 to 90 minutes depending on endpoint and update state
recipes.validation_method: Collect the Active Response result marker, check update state, and run a targeted verification scan.
